d.t: SHIM FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVER FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Pedestal Shim is an accessory used on top of adjustable pedestals to create a dampener to account for minute height differences between the pedestal and the paver, created from the uneven surface of the installation substrate. Shims are manufactured from recycled thermoplastic elastomer (TPE) and may be cut into 4 corners to support individual paver corners. SikaRoof VersiJack Pedestal Shim, with its cushioning material, fills the small gaps also to prevent rocking and knocking of pavers on the surface.
a: Cushioning layer between paver and pedestal
Prevents rocking and knocking of pavers
Accounts for minute differences in heights
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Shims are used with adjustable pedestals for raised paver flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
